mapper.select: select * from room where host_no = #{hostNo} order by created_at desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from room where host_no = #{hostNo}
select exists (select 1 from room where room.no = #{roomNo} and room.host_no = #{hostNo})

select R.no AS roomNo, R.host_no AS hostNo, R.password, R.title, R.code, R.capacity, R.created_at AS createdAt, R.type, R.visibility, Q.status from room R join qna_room Q on R.no = Q.room_no where R.no = #{roomNo} and R.host_no = #{hostNo}
select COUNT(*) from room where code = #{code}

select R.no as roomNo, R.host_no as hostNo, R.password as password, R.title as title, R.code as code, R.capacity as capacity, R.created_at as createdAt, R.type as type, R.visibility as visibility, Q.status as status, case when Q.status = 'QUESTION_OPEN' then Q.question_started_at when Q.status = 'VOTING_OPEN' then Q.voting_started_at else null end as phase_started_at, case when Q.status = 'QUESTION_OPEN' then Q.question_ended_at when Q.status = 'VOTING_OPEN' then Q.voting_ended_at else null end as phase_ended_at from room R join qna_room Q on R.no = Q.room_no where Q.room_no = #{roomNo}
